title: The argument for animals holds equally for humans

statements.text: The argument that applies to animals holds equally of humans. Every state of consciousness in humans is caused by molecular changes in the brain, and nothing shows that any state of consciousness causes a change in the motion of the matter of the organism.

sources.quote: It seems to me that in men, as in brutes, there is no proof that any state of consciousness is the cause of change in the motion of the matter of the organism.
